definitions.explanation: A reddish-brown metallic element widely used for electrical wiring, coins, and alloys. Also used in compounds relating to bronze medals and copper products.

examples.japanese: ⟦{銅|どう}メダル→銅メダル：22344_doumedaru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{銅|どう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This pot is made of copper.

examples.japanese: {銅|どう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧だ。
examples.english: Copper is a metal that conducts heat well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{奈良|なら}→奈良：27451_nara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大仏|だいぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{銅|どう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{造|つく}られている→造る：17751_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: The Great Buddha of Nara is made of copper.

notes:
{銅|どう} refers to both the metal copper and, in compounds, bronze (an alloy of copper and tin). Most commonly encountered in the context of ⟦{銅|どう}メダル→銅メダル：22344_doumedaru⟧ (bronze medal).

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{銅|どう}メダル→銅メダル：22344_doumedaru⟧: bronze medal
- ⟦{銅像|どうぞう}→銅像：14471_douzou⟧: bronze statue
- ⟦{銅貨|どうか}→銅貨：00038_douka⟧: copper coin
- {銅|どう}{板|いた}: copper plate
- {銅色|どういろ}: copper color
- {青銅|せいどう}: bronze (copper-tin alloy)

OLYMPIC MEDALS:
- ⟦{金|きん}メダル→金メダル：20781_kinmedaru⟧: gold medal
- ⟦{銀|ぎん}メダル→銀メダル：22343_ginmedaru⟧: silver medal
- ⟦{銅|どう}メダル→銅メダル：22344_doumedaru⟧: bronze medal

CULTURAL NOTE:
Copper has been important in Japanese craftsmanship for centuries. Many famous Buddhist statues, including the ⟦{奈良|なら}→奈良：27451_nara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大仏|だいぶつ} (Great Buddha of Nara), are made of {銅|どう}.
